title: Job posting tagging
description: Tag job postings for a job board's search filters: where the work happens, seniority, job function and whether visa sponsorship is offered. All postings and employers are fictional.

questions.instructions: Where does the job expect the person to work?

criteria.remote: No regular office attendance. Occasional meetups or quarterly visits still count as remote.
criteria.hybrid: A regular pattern of some office days and some home days.
criteria.onsite: At the employer's site every working day.

levels.text: Entry: interns, apprentices, graduates, or up to about 2 years' experience.
Mid: about 2 to 5 years' experience, working independently.
Senior: about 5 or more years, an expert individual contributor without direct reports.
Lead: manages people or runs a team, including supervisors, managers, heads and directors.

criteria.data: Data science, analytics, data engineering and machine learning.
criteria.design: Product, UX, research and brand design.
criteria.sales: Selling, account management and sales development.
criteria.operations: Office, warehouse, logistics and facilities operations.

questions.instructions: The posting explicitly offers visa sponsorship.

criteria.true: States that the employer can or will sponsor a visa for this role.
criteria.false: Says nothing about sponsorship, rules it out, or requires an existing right to work.
